indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Third straight loss as chip stocks slid again in the afternoon.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Led the decline as investors kept moving money out of tech.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Rose as money shifted into consumer, financial and home-improvement names.

notes: The tech sell-off continued: Marvell fell about 13% after agreeing to buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal, Lumentum dropped about 19%, and Oracle lost around 9% after announcing a large stock and bond raise.
Oil tumbled about 7–8% on reports that the US and Iran are seeking a diplomatic way out, with WTI near $96 and Brent just under $105.
The Dow held up on gains in names like Home Depot and Sherwin-Williams, IDEXX jumped about 22% on strong results, and the ISM manufacturing survey came in better than expected.
events: Tue 3 Nov: US midterm elections; AMD reports after the US close (early Wed in Kuwait).
Fri 6 Nov, 16:30 Kuwait time: US October jobs report.
